name: Dona Marlene (Licit)
origem: previa A (provisoria, a confirmar pelo usuario)
descricao: A 54-year-old Brazilian woman, owner of a small cleaning-supplies shop in the interior of Brazil. Native Brazilian Portuguese with a light countryside accent. Firm, direct, slightly rough mid-low voice, practical and a bit suspicious, speaks fast like someone quoting a price at the counter. Natural conversational delivery, not an announcer. Clean studio recording.
